title: platform-standup-2026-03-31
content:
Platform Engineering Standup - 2026-03-31
Attendees: Maria, Evan, Priya, Samir, Lena, Jae
Note: Informal notes + action list. Posting here for visibility; will sync with Confluence summary later.

1) Quick wins / announcements
- Rolled out short-lived token support for internal control-plane calls to staging (PR merged: platform/pulls/456). Smoke tests green.
- Quota dashboard prototype is live behind feature-flag for a small set of customers (see CONFLUENCE-PLAT-42).
- Reminder: Dedicated capacity autoscaler tuning session tomorrow at 10am PST.

2) Control plane
- Evan: Fixed a race condition in the config reload path that caused duplicate route entries when we refreshed model manifests under concurrent updates. Patch deployed to staging.
  - Follow-up: add unit test for concurrent manifest reloads (owner: Evan, JIRA: PLAT-1012).
- Maria: Observed increased read latency on /v1/model-metadata (p95 ~230ms in staging). Tracing points to auth middleware doing synchronous KMS calls for a small % of requests. Temporary mitigation: caching KMS verifications for 60s for staging only. Need production-safe plan.
  - Action: Priya to propose KMS verification cache TTL and safety checks by EOD Friday.

3) Routing & Smart routing policies
- Priya: Working on policy engine to prefer cheaper variants under load. Prototype can route low-priority requests to quantized variants. Integration tests flaky when preferences change mid-request.
  - Blocker: need consistent model-variant compatibility mapping in control plane. Samir to add mapping API (JIRA: PLAT-1015).
- Load-testing notes: 4/1 run will include mixed sequence lengths; need to ensure routing decisions respect sequence-length histogram. Evan to add histogram sampling to request router.

4) Auth & tokens
- Samir: Short-lived token rollout to staging succeeded. Observed 0.3% token refresh failures due to clock skew on some CI runners.
  - Action: add diagnostic header to token responses with server timestamp to help clients diagnose skew (owner: Samir).
- Discussion: rotation cadence for internal service keys. Proposal: rotate every 30 days with 7-day overlap window. Put up RFC next week.

5) Quotas & billing controls
- Lena: Prototype quota engine supports per-route and per-model quotas. Edge case: burst protection interacts poorly with Dedicated reserved pools — customers saw quota rejects even when reserved capacity available.
  - Root cause: reserved pool assignment not being considered for quota checks. Priority fix scheduled (JIRA: PLAT-1020).
- Need to define error codes for quota vs capacity rejections so SDKs can surface correct UX. Action: Maria to draft error-code schema and notify SDK teams.

6) Observability / SRE items
- Alerts: New alert for repeated 429s from quota engine added. Tune threshold after 4/1 load run.
- Tracing: add span for policy-evaluation time (target <5ms p95). Priya to instrument.

7) Blockers and risks
- PROD risk: If the KMS synchronous verification remains in the auth path, p95 latency could regress under traffic spikes. Mitigation: caching + async verification fallback; need design review.
- Rollout risk: Smart routing fallback logic currently lacks a clear rollback if variant compatibility check fails; could cause increased 500s. Samir to scope a canary + kill-switch.

8) Action items (owners + dates)
- Evan: Add unit tests for concurrent manifest reloads (PLAT-1012) - due 2026-04-02.
- Priya: Propose KMS TTL + safety checks (PRD section) - due 2026-04-03.
- Samir: Add mapping API for model-variant compatibility + token diagnostic header - due 2026-04-02.
- Maria: Draft error-code schema for quota vs capacity rejects and notify SDK teams - due 2026-04-02.
- Lena: Implement reserved-pool-aware quota checks (PLAT-1020) - start 2026-04-01, target 2026-04-05.
- Priya: Instrument policy-evaluation span in router (target <5ms p95) - due 2026-04-04.

9) Notes / todos / follow-ups
- Follow up on 4/1 mixed-length load test; capture router decision logs for troubleshooting.
- Add smoke test that simulates reserved capacity assignments + quota checks.
- Schedule short design review for KMS caching approach next Wednesday.

10) Misc / FYI
- Customer success reported an enterprise customer asking about per-route quotas and SLA for dedicated pools; Maria to sync with CS next week to confirm expectations.
- PR checklist reminder: include benchmark numbers and compatibility matrix for any change touching routing or model variants.

End of notes.
